items.action: Append `-color` to every DS token whose name ends in `-bg`. Covers the public `--ds-<component>-…-bg` hooks on avatar, badge, banner, button, card, date-picker, dropzone, empty-state, icon-button, input, modal, pagination, search, sidenav, stat, table, tabs, tag, toast and topbar, plus the globals `--select-bg`, `--chart-hover-bg`, `--chart-tooltip-bg` and the `--status-<x>-bg` set.
items.appliesWhen: Only to DS-owned tokens. Your own variables ending in `-bg` are untouched, and the private `--_*` internals renamed in lockstep have no public hook, so they need nothing.
items.pitfall: A blind search-and-replace on `-bg` renames YOUR variables too, and the result still compiles — a custom property resolves to nothing and the element silently loses its background. Before replacing a name, confirm the `-color` spelling exists in the installed 0.3.0 package under `themes/` or `styles/`; if it does not, the token was yours.
items.note: The tokens held only a colour and now feed `background-color`, so the name says which property it reaches.

items.action: For each `-fg` token you override, look the replacement up in the installed 0.3.0 package (`themes/`, `styles/`, and the component SCSS) and use the exact name you find. Three suffixes are in play and the split is real: at 0.3.0 the sources carry 23 `-text-color`, 49 `-label-color` and 21 `-icon-color`.
items.appliesWhen: Only to DS-owned tokens. A variable of your own ending in `-fg` is untouched.
items.pitfall: The suffix is NOT derivable from the old name, so guessing produces a name nothing reads and a silently unstyled element. Same shape, three answers: `--ds-modal-title-fg` became `-text-color`, `--ds-sidenav-group-fg` became `-label-color`, `--ds-icon-button-fg` became `-icon-color`.
items.note: The `fg` abbreviation was dropped for a suffix that says what the token paints — text, a control or nav label, or a glyph. It covers the public `--ds-<component>-…-fg` hooks on avatar, badge, banner, breadcrumbs, button, date-picker, dropzone, empty-state, icon-button, input, menu, modal, page-header, pagination, search, sidenav, table, tabs, tag and topbar, plus the `--status-*` and chart-tooltip globals.
items.verify: No stylesheet declares or reads a --ds-*-fg token; each one names the semantic replacement its component reads (-text-color / -label-color / -icon-color).

items.action: Read every caption you pass in `[steps]` as on-screen text and reword the ones written to be heard rather than seen. `labelPosition` (`bottom` | `inline`, default `bottom`) sets where they sit.
items.pitfall: Nothing breaks and no build fails, so this ships unless somebody looks. Captions authored for a screen reader tend to carry the context the screen already gives — "Step 2 of 5: enter your details" reads fine when announced and badly when printed under a numbered dot.
items.note: `[steps]` takes a `readonly string[]`, and those strings used to be screen-reader-only: on screen a step showed only its number. They render as visible labels now.
items.verify: Every caption passed in [steps] is written to be READ on screen, not only announced - they render visibly now.

informational: Reactive-forms (ControlValueAccessor) on ds-input / ds-textarea / ds-select ([(value)] signal API unchanged, both work) — additive.

ng add support (wires the global styles import idempotently); ds-combobox size input (+ComboboxSize); overridable focus-ring token system (--ds-field-focus-shadow / --ds-control-focus-shadow groups + per-component --ds-<comp>-focus-shadow hooks, default appearance unchanged); ds-tag hover tokens; --opacity-state-active overlay token — all additive.

Visual-only: tag close button gains a pressed state; accordion & sidenav-group animate open/close (collapsed content now stays in the DOM marked inert instead of being removed); ds-combobox focus uses the soft field halo; repo-wide value-preserving CSS modernization (background-color precision, modern hsl()/clip-path/range media syntax).
Fixes: ds-drawer closes on Escape when focus left the panel; ds-combobox 'No matches' row no longer selectable.
